articles.summary: Elizabeth Greiner, Content Manager at Flo Recruit, sat down with Anna D’Alesandro, Legal Recruiting and Integration Coordinator and Kayla Allen, Senior Manager - Legal Talent Development at Vorys, to discuss their transition from spreadsheets and a custom Access Database to Flo Recruit Applicant Tracking for law student, lateral associate, partner, and patent professional recruitment.
articles.title: How Vorys Transitioned to Flo’s ATS with Historical Data
